input.prompt: Read only the exact text in the text field. The text field is the complete script. Do not repeat, add, explain, translate, paraphrase, or continue it. Stop immediately after the final Arabic word. Say the Turkish label once, then recite the Arabic Quran text once, with a short natural pause after the label.
input.text: Mü'min altmış yedinci ayet. هُوَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَكُم مِّن تُرَابٍۢ ثُمَّ مِن نُّطْفَةٍۢ ثُمَّ مِنْ عَلَقَةٍۢ ثُمَّ يُخْرِجُكُمْ طِفْلًۭا ثُمَّ لِتَبْلُغُوٓا۟ أَشُدَّكُمْ ثُمَّ لِتَكُونُوا۟ شُيُوخًۭا ۚ وَمِنكُم مَّن يُتَوَفَّىٰ مِن قَبْلُ ۖ وَلِتَبْلُغُوٓا۟ أَجَلًۭا مُّسَمًّۭى وَلَعَلَّكُمْ تَعْقِلُونَ
